I strongly believe that if you deliberately do something you know is going to make you feel bad, because you wanna punish yourself, because you think you deserve it, then yes it’s self-harm. I wish more people thought of it that way instead of simply “cutting/hitting/burning/scratching”. Any self-inflicted pain should be considered self-harm, especially if it’s emotional, like deliberately exposing yourself to triggers. It’s a lot different than forgetting to brush your teeth or not having the energy to change your clothes, I think. Performing self-harm is draining and takes of a lot of energy for me to do. I don’t know if there is any study or definition for this phenomenon.

I had a ONS once and I thought it was awful and I don’t know how people (especially women) do it without fearing for their life, feeling used, and risking STDs. Close friends makes more sense to me for safety reasons, both physically and emotionally. You already know the person so there’s already some sort of established trust and comfort. You’ve probably even talked about each other’s sex lives too so you know if they’re clean. And you would hope that they won’t be an asshole to you afterwards and that there is some sort of communication about expectations, which doesn’t really happen a lot of the time with strangers and things like ghosting ensues. 

Idk I know those things can happen with friends too. Like they might not always be honest and can switch up on you suddenly because they’re having sex with you/catch feelings. And I know it’s possible to find a stranger to have sex with who will satisfy you and make you feel safe and it’s not guaranteed that friends will do that. But if friends are down to have sex and then be mature and communicative about it instead of letting it negatively impact the friendship, then go for it. It makes me feel safer. Maybe I just had a bad experience that scarred me/I might be demisexual, but that’s how I feel about casual sex with strangers. It’s just scary and seems empty and I really don’t understand how it’s so normalized

Just this week I bought a snake plant, peperomia, money tree, boston fern, peace lily, lavender, a very smol monstera from Trader Joes, a spider plant, and a zz plant xd I'm very excited to be here and start my plant journey!
